strengthened_mathematics: If X -> Y=pi(X) -> Z is a coarse-graining/processing chain, I(X;Z)<=I(X;Y) by the data-processing inequality.
A right inverse/section R with pi o R=id exists only on an appropriate image/domain and does not imply R o pi=id on the full higher-dimensional state space.
Reconstruction error can be made explicit: E_rec=E[d(X,R(pi(X)))].
For a quantum channel, exact universal copying of an arbitrary unknown pure state is forbidden by the no-cloning theorem; reconstruction must therefore be distinguished from duplication.

A proposed invariant I* must be derived from a symmetry, sufficient statistic, topological invariant, conserved current, or other explicit mechanism rather than postulated because dimensions are related.
